    rw [TensorProduct.smul_tmul', smul_eq_mul, mul_one]
  rw [ht, map_smul, Submodule.coe_smul, hm]
  rfl
· apply top_unique
  rw [← c.span_eq]
  apply Submodule.span_mono
  rintro _ ⟨i, rfl⟩
  rw [← hfc]
  exact Submodule.subset_span (f i).property
